events.title: Martin Luther King Jr. is named winner of the Nobel Peace Prize
events.summary: The civil rights leader is honored for his nonviolent struggle against racial discrimination.
events.description: On October 14, 1964, Martin Luther King Jr. was named the winner of the Nobel Peace Prize. The prize recognized his nonviolent struggle for civil rights for Black Americans.
